name: robots/erfanmhi__deep-reinforcement-learning-cs285-pytorch
title: CS285 obstacles-cs285-v0 (2D navigation)
intro: CS285 obstacles-cs285-v0 (2D navigation), adapted from erfanmhi/deep-reinforcement-learning-cs285-pytorch. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
